policies.analysis_unit: Unique ERA5 grid; sites sharing a grid are not independent climate samples.
policies.bbox_candidates: Conservative bounding-box sensitivity candidates, not confirmed factory-polygon coverage or a position confidence interval.
policies.primary_result: The accepted representative-point grid and its result are preserved. No replacement by an alternative land grid.
policies.non_land: land_mask != 1: annual and daily climate values withheld, not zero-filled.
policies.incomplete_summer: Incomplete summers remain in annual records and are excluded from summary metrics.
policies.daily_precision: Decoded NetCDF daily values are serialized without display rounding; non-finite values become JSON null.
policies.interpretation: Historical environmental conditions at current mapped locations; no site existence, employee exposure, trend significance or occupational-compliance inference.

heat_index_global_attributes.title: Humid heat risk indices for East China
heat_index_global_attributes.hourly_variables: not saved for multi-year runs; recompute them from the raw files if needed

heat_index_variable_attributes.description: Daily maximum of the hourly NOAA/Rothfusz heat index over local calendar days (UTC+8); NaN if any hour is missing

risk_global_attributes.title: Heat risk categories for East China
risk_global_attributes.source: Based on ERA5 hourly single-level reanalysis

land_mask_variable_attributes.description: 1 = land (ERA5 land_sea_mask >= 0.5), 0 = sea; risk area fractions count land cells only

source_metadata.land_mask_rule: 1 = land (ERA5 land_sea_mask >= 0.5), 0 = sea; risk area fractions count land cells only
source_metadata.metadata_interpretation: The derived variable units, long_name and description describe heat index. GRIB_* fields are retained original metadata and include raw temperature/K labels; no unit conversion is applied to this package.
source_metadata.note: The source daily heat-index variable retains conflicting inherited GRIB temperature/K metadata. This package uses its derived units=Celsius, long_name and description, consistent with src/process_humid_heat.py heat-index processing. GRIB_* attributes are preserved for review; original NetCDF files and numeric values are unchanged, with no 273.15 conversion.
